author: Yffe
content: Failing tests at forge/tests/divergence_holed_lowering.rs::{divergence_build_emits_artifact_for_holed_item, divergence_body_tv_reports_holed_body_faithful} demonstrate the divergence. Root cause: only check::check_file_with_options consults FnItem.holes; because a hole is NOT a Stmt variant, every other lowering path (build::build_file front, body_tv, exec_tv corpus mode) lowers the hole-stripped body — the open goal vanishes into a valid program. Observed: forge build on 'fn main { ?0  42 }' emits an rlib + 'assurance: L1' manifest, exit 0; body-tv reports 'main — faithful'. Authority: goal-repl.md REQ-4/REQ-5 (no lowering, no verus; L0-equivalent until every hole is filled), ast.rs FnItem.holes contract ('a holed item never lowers'), thermite-design.md §6 (the build manifest is the trust statement).
